assignment: baseline-selected whole-object C1/C2, identical assignment for P and Q in targets AND reported metrics
calibration: min primary subject to median/P90 nonworse and good damage<=.005; tie tolerance1e-12 higher tau; infeasible -> always P without extra grid
oracle_gate: primary relative gain>=.01 AND median/P90 nonworse
real_DEV: only after all 3 seeds pass; fixed weights/tau
success: all 3 seeds: primary>=1%, median/P90/coverage nonworse, damage<=.005, catastrophic0; all selected-Q mean gains>0 and seed mean realized gain>0
tau_units: raw px equivalent = predicted normalized gain * frame raw diagonal
upstream_seed_selection: first numeric seed; no upstream seed comparison
